title: Dedupe with Window
description:
Event logs may contain duplicate `user_id` rows from retries. Keep **one row per user_id** — the row with the **earliest** `event_time`.

Use a window function (`row_number` over `partitionBy("user_id").orderBy("event_time")`) and filter to rank 1. Assign the result to `deduped`.

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy('user_id').orderBy('event_time')
deduped = df.withColumn('rn', row_number().over(w)).filter('rn = 1')
